notes.title: UPDATE ON 10YA 0.0.9
notes.notes:
As you are aware 10YA has been on hold for a few weeks i can assure you all that it is back under development full time and that during the time that has passed 10YA is under going some major changes to the story and the world ,

the biggest change is the timeline as 10YA was originally set in the present day the new 10YA will be set sometime in the future also the story's main plot being about the injection is still intact but instead of zombies they are now "reaper" like creatures 

also due to 10YA now being set in the future it opens up the possibility of space flight and new worlds (theses are under development as we speak) 
and of course more futuristic weapons , factions will be in place also. 
so to some it up 10YA is now a universe rather than a planet and all the horrors that go with it 

also at the moment we are trying out a 3rd person controller with regards as replacing the 1st person .....it is just testing at the moment and a small video will be uploaded soon of a test we made showing off the new look 10YA 

Stay Safe Afters

First off i know this patch has taken longer than most and it is still ongoing but we have almost successfully moved to unity 5 now.

notes.title: Update On Alpha 0.0.7
notes.notes:
Well as you are aware we are working mostly on the outside areas including the city and the town things are going well a few problems have come about but we are mostly on course for the update coming out this weekend coming!...

What i can confirm is that 10YA is being completely re-worked from the start of the game to the outside area and during some initial tests we are getting a solid 60FPS in the new outside area!

Also as a way to achieve the fps and up the graphics a notch we have separated the towns from the woodlands.

So now you will find and follow a few roads (where you will find infected who have made there way out of the town/city)  until you get asked if you would like to enter the city/town.

You are still free to wander about and come and go as you please between the town/city and the woodlands areas.

During testing this way and dynamic loading it as you walk around we found this way we were able to really up the graphics and keep a nice steady fps rate.

This has also let us drastically increase the size of the city and the town and let us add more grasses and better trees and textures on the woodlands area.

You will also now still start in the flats but you will escape to an outside area where you will have to make your way through the streets and enter the hospital ...the rest we shall keep secret :-)

As i have already said we hope to have this out for 14th/15th of this month as long as things go well,

Depending on the feedback of 0.0.7 we shall then start addressing some of the smaller things for a 0.0.7a patch and then hopefully we can start adding in some cool stuff for 0.0.8


Stay Safe Afters

notes.title: Today's Patch 0.0.6a
notes.notes:
[h1] Patch 0.0.6a may break your last save[/h1] 

[b] Bugs Fixed:[/b] 

- Clipping zombies (Dev has confirmed next update hopefully) ///// [b] Adjusted "infected" collider animations and attack/listen distance to help combat this issue working on better AI to completely fix this[/b] 


- Zombies are hard as nails! (dev to test and rethink health of zeds)///// [b] "infected" Health Now Reduced[/b] 


- The camp-fire is lit by Leon but flame is switched off by accident, next build ;)///// [b] "Fires are now Lit"[/b] 


- All of the sheds by Alexis Ridge have no clipping.///// [b] Sheds Now Fixed[/b] 


- Woodside doesn't exist in the game, the marker is from an old build. ///// [b] Woodside is in Build[/b] 


- Thirst/ hunger go down too fast and aren't replenished enough by certain items.///// [b] Hunger/Thirst Adjusted may need more depending on feedback[/b] 


- Crafting costs too many materials.///// [b] Reduced Crafting Cost on some items[/b] 


- Day/ Night cycle is very short.///// [b] Extended day/night Cycle possible more depending on feedback[/b] 


-Removed Confusing Main Menu ///// [b] Replaced with Basic Menu for now PLEASE NOTE: you can not adjust graphics or volume etc you can still use "P" in game to drop or raise graphic settings[/b] 


- Fall damage takes an ok amount of health, but maybe shouldn't kick in for lower heights. ///// [b] Fall Damage slightly adjusted[/b] 


- I would recommend the amount hostile bandits taunt/ threaten you be lowered. (Risks becoming a broken record (Ofc will help when there's more taunts/ threats!)). ///// [b] removed for now[/b] 


- There is an invisible wall between Alexis house and the powerline next to it (By the shed). ///// [b] Removed powerline as believe this was causing this invisible  wall[/b] 


- Added Better [b] "Space to Skip" information[/b] 


- [b] "L" now turns flash-light on/off[/b]  also you now don't lose it and will always have your flash-light 



[h1] Next Patch will address outside Area and Head shots This will Fix These Issues[/h1] 

-Known fps drop when 'leaning' (Q/E or LB/ RB (Xbox controller) - Otherwise controller support In its current partial state works fine and will be updated to include inventory and communicate with npc.

- Distant Terrain/ LOD could do with improving.

- WHEN OUTSIDE FOR NOW, PLEASE LOWER GRAPHICAL SETTINGS ON LOWER RIGS - The game currently loads the whole outdoor terrain map including city at once, of course this is temporary. I have i7-3770k, 16GB RAM & GTX 970 MSI OC and get between 30-60 (Dipping very low at times). THIS CAN LEAD TO A GREEN SCREEN CRASH.

- Separate hitboxes for zombies heads are needed, as currently taking many headhits to kill

- Day/ Night cycle is very short.///// [b] Extended day/night Cycle possible more depending on feedback[/b] 


-Removed Confusing Main Menu ///// [b] Replaced with Basic Menu for now PLEASE NOTE: you can not adjust graphics or volume etc you can still use "P" in game to drop or raise graphic settings[/b] 


- Fall damage takes an ok amount of health, but maybe shouldn't kick in for lower heights. ///// [b] Fall Damage slightly adjusted[/b] 


- I would recommend the amount hostile bandits taunt/ threaten you be lowered. (Risks becoming a broken record (Ofc will help when there's more taunts/ threats!)). ///// [b] removed for now[/b] 


- There is an invisible wall between Alexis house and the powerline next to it (By the shed). ///// [b] Removed powerline as believe this was causing this invisible  wall[/b] 


- Added Better [b] "Space to Skip" information[/b] 


- [b] "L" now turns flash-light on/off[/b]  also you now don't lose it and will always have your flash-light 



[h1] Next Patch will address outside Area and Head shots This will Fix These Issues[/h1] 

-Known fps drop when 'leaning' (Q/E or LB/ RB (Xbox controller) - Otherwise controller support In its current partial state works fine and will be updated to include inventory and communicate with npc.

- Distant Terrain/ LOD could do with improving.

- WHEN OUTSIDE FOR NOW, PLEASE LOWER GRAPHICAL SETTINGS ON LOWER RIGS - The game currently loads the whole outdoor terrain map including city at once, of course this is temporary. I have i7-3770k, 16GB RAM & GTX 970 MSI OC and get between 30-60 (Dipping very low at times). THIS CAN LEAD TO A GREEN SCREEN CRASH.

- Separate hitboxes for zombies heads are needed, as currently taking many headhits to kill

notes.title: Update On First Patch
notes.notes:
Just a quick update to let you know we will be starting work on the first Steam patch on Monday, We will be working through the list on the "Bugs and Stuff" thread in the forum so if you can think of anything please just add it to that thread.

We hope to have this live for Friday it may come in two patches one to fix all the smaller items and another to try and nail down the FPS drops when outside...We may have to remake the outside into smaller parts that load around you as you go if this is the case then this will take a bit longer to push out due to all the work involved  but we will see :-)

Also just wanted to say thanks to everyone who has brought the game on Steam and also its nice to see so many Desura users getting in-touch

Stay Safe Afters
